newsitem.title: CHINA: Downtown fire kills seven in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Downtown fire kills seven in Shanghai.

text.p: The cause of a fire in an appartment building in downtown Shanghai that left seven people dead was still being investigated, an official said on Thursday.
Several people were still missing and 19 were injured in addition to the seven killed, officials said.

The fire, which broke out around midnight on Tuesday, destroyed three floors of a crowded apartment building that was home to 250 residents as well as nine offices, the Liberation Daily newspaper said on Thursday.
One 73-year-old man jumped from his second-floor apartment and received bruises to his chest, neck and arms, the newspaper said.
The report said a fireman was badly injured in the fire, but gave no more details.
